item.title: Remodeling Underway - Pickler Memorial Library
item.description: Pardon the noise as work begins on the Doug and Diane Villhard Innovation Lab located at the north end of the first floor. The installation of the walls is slated to be completed by January 27 with necessary electrical and networking wiring to follow.
